evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep did not use the time-boxed framing ('10 to 15 minutes,' 'dependable quote') or pause for confirmation before launching into probing.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Asked after probing: 'before I go over the details, do you have any questions or concerns you would like answered on this call besides pricing?' — this came after confirming contact info and mentioning the September 25th request. Customer responded with pricing as only concern.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer said 'pricing is just my biggest question' — no concerns raised beyond pricing, so N/A applies.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: No reflection back of concerns; N/A because customer raised no substantive concern to reflect.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Covered: destination address, unit floor/access (second floor, long hallway, 100 feet walk, stairs), storage type (indoor first floor). Did NOT ask property type of origin, number of rooms, or additional stops. Partial coverage — items listed but not systematically probed.
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: Not asked; customer volunteered 'about twenty BDM to large boxes' but rep did not offer the typical-count framing or overflow check.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Full: 'I would estimate this move to fall within that two and a half hour minimum... and then I would look to budget $550 and then if you happen to fall within the three and a half hour range, it'd be $770.' Personalized to short distance and minimal items.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Full: disclosed hourly rate ($220), mentioned fuel/taxes/insurance, tools included, 2.5-hour minimum, 15-minute increments: 'The way the clock works is the time starts as soon as we get on site and open the contract you then have us for as long as you need us for any move. We do have a two and a half hour minimum once we go over that minimum the, it's prorated in fifteen minute increments.'
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Asked: 'Does that sound fair?' Customer immediately responded 'Yes ma'am' — no true silence held, but the question was asked plainly.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: Full: 'we do have an on time guarantee we value your time. So, if we can't make it in the time window that we arrange, we immediately start discounting.'
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: Partial: mentioned coverage and $2,000 amount ('provides up to $2,000 per move to repair, replace or reimburse for accidental damages') but did NOT explicitly state no deductible, no fine print, or that it's built into the rate — only named it 'free evaluation cover that's included in our hourly rate.'
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: No closing question asked ('Does that put those to rest?'); rep moved directly to the ask.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Never asked. After pricing pushback ('your quote did come back a couple of $100 more'), rep did not re-engage with a genuine 'What's still concerning you?' — went straight to closing pleasantries.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Full: 'Would you like us to help you with that move on Friday?' — plainly asked, no built-in out.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Partial: arrival window confirmed (12:30–2:30 PM), date confirmed (Friday, September 25th), addresses in notes from discovery. Did NOT confirm phone number again for crew day-of contact, did NOT confirm crew size, and did NOT explicitly leave notes about customer's specific concerns (long hallway walk) for the crew — though rep mentioned 'Notes, which shouldn't make too much of a difference' without clarifying what was documented.

top_strength: Brianne gathered detailed logistics on a complex access situation (100-foot hallway walk, second-floor stairs, indoor storage unit) that will directly inform crew setup, and delivered a tightly anchored estimate ($550 to $770 range) personalized to a short-distance, minimal-item move.
coaching_note: Open with the quid-pro-quo framing (time-boxed, promise of a dependable quote, wait for yes) before jumping into probing—it resets the customer's expectation that this is a structured conversation, not just a rapid intake.
